components.visibleText:
EXTREME HAZARD DOSSIER: BIO-ENGINEER MISSION BRIEF
CONFIDENTIAL FILE – AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY.
You are a Bio-Engineer. Your mission is to design a new plant species to survive in a high-salt, low-water desert flat.

The Challenge:
1. Name your plant.
2. Design one Structural adaptation to help it survive.
3. Design one Functional adaptation to help it survive.
Work in pairs. You have 3 minutes. Be prepared to pitch your organism to the class.
